comparison.objective: Sever a cable tie beside its head with flush cutters without nicking the cable bundle, then return the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a bundle while positioning and closing cutter jaws at a safe location; this is guarded cutting rather than flush end-face mating and supported sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the tie cut and removed, insulation undamaged, bundle retained on supports and cutters returned; candidate instead gates on complete block transfer and preservation of every circulating ball.
comparison.reason: The only commonality is bimanual damage avoidance. This record tests safe cutting-tool placement and actuation, not continuous support, alignment-preserving regrasp or loose-element containment. Unspecified candidate gap and force thresholds do not suggest duplication.
